summary: You present a compelling Australian reef-monitoring mission, a mission-linked project plan with contingencies, and useful initial orbit calculations. To strengthen the report, validate that the proposed satellite sensor can detect bleaching and substantiate coverage assumptions with sensor and access analysis. Clear structure and references support a professional presentation; more complete source details and precise citations would improve it further.
next_steps: In Mission Concept & Rationale, verify that the proposed spectral bands can distinguish bleaching, and discuss water depth, turbidity and atmospheric correction. Check that the cited airborne method applies to a satellite sensor, and clarify the source and meaning of the stated 30% ocean-acidification increase.

In Preliminary Progress, identify a plausible imager and justify its usable swath, viewing geometry and image quality. Treat the 2,700 km figure as approximate equatorial track displacement, then use orbit geometry and sensor field of view to assess usable coverage over the Reef.

In Information Sources and References, provide complete bibliographic details and precise citations for technical claims. In the project plan, continue tying tasks and contingencies to mission dependencies, and specify milestones where this would make progress easier to assess.

criteria.C1: Mission Concept & Rationale clearly defines the Reef-monitoring purpose, users and measurable objectives, supported by literature. To make the concept more defensible, validate bleaching detection for the proposed satellite sensor, including spectral bands and water and atmospheric effects; clarify the cited 30% acidity claim.
criteria.C2: Your week-by-week Gantt chart (Figure 1), information sources (Table 2) and contingencies (Table 1) make a robust, mission-linked plan. To strengthen it further, specify key milestones and keep the planned analysis tied to validating sensor performance and usable Reef coverage.
criteria.C3: Preliminary Progress includes candidate-orbit calculations and an STK scenario checked against the hand-calculated period. Build on this by specifying the assumed sensor and testing usable swath and Reef access; distinguish the approximate 2,700 km equatorial track displacement from demonstrated imaging coverage.
criteria.C4: Your report is logically structured, readable, and uses labelled figures and tables with in-text citations. Improve the professional finish by giving complete bibliographic details for sources such as the Nature and NOAA items and precise references for technical claims.
